text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "He was president of CURAVIVA Switzerland (Association of Swiss Care Homes and Social Institutions) and of Curafutura, the association of innovative health insurers.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "He has lectured at various universities in Switzerland."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Il a été à la tête des associations CURAVIVA Suisse (Homes et Institutions Sociales Suisses) et curafutura, Les assureurs-maladie innovants.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Il a été chargé de cours dans plusieurs universités en Suisse."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Ignazio Cassis est entré au Conseil national en 2007 comme représentant tessinois du parti libéral-radical.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Ignazio Cassis was elected to the National Council as a member of the FDP for the canton of Ticino in 2007."}]}
